reason: A read-only usage analytics plugin that replays session logs and observes live tool calls to provide skill invocation statistics, session views, deletion markers, and trend visualizations.

summaries.zh: 只读统计技能调用次数、会话使用情况和调用趋势，并通过面板与 API 展示历史及实时使用数据。
summaries.en: A read-only plugin that tracks skill invocation counts, session usage, and trends from historical logs and live events through a dashboard and API.

capabilities: Reads persisted host session logs to count skill invocations
Subscribes to live tool-call events for incremental statistics
Maintains an incremental local cache of usage data
Provides a local statistics API and web dashboard with tables and trend charts
